name: Bangkok
tagline: The crab omelette in ski goggles that Netflix made famous, and three Michelin stars for a pair of German twins.

Jay Fai.description: Thailand's most famous crab omelette, cooked in ski goggles over a charcoal wok. The world's first street food stall to win a Michelin star, star of Netflix's Chef's Table.

Sühring.description: German twins reinventing their home cuisine in Bangkok. Three Michelin stars, the first German restaurant in Asia to achieve it.

Thip Samai.description: The city's most famous egg-wrapped pad thai, on Maha Chai Street since 1966.

Gaggan Anand.description: Progressive Indian cuisine with French, Thai, and Japanese technique, at a 14-seat counter with a 25-course theatrical menu. Michelin star.

Krua Apsorn (Dusit).description: Royal Thai recipes since 1996, inherited from the Princess Mother's cook. Bib Gourmand.
